Source.evidence_source: [/page/15/Text/6] The first goal of Study 2 was to test the stability of explanatory style in Chinese children over time. Over the 8-month period, explanatory style remained fairly stable. The correlations for explanatory style composite score, and the scores for the negative and positive events were all significant (see Table 2).
Source.warning: Rater for explanatory style not explicitly stated, inferred as youth self-report based on common practice for this measure in children.
